title: BowJil's Refreshed Combat
description: Refresh Your Combat Tools With This Resource Pack!
body:
BowJil's Refreshed Combat is the second Resource Pack of my "Refreshed" series that gives Minecraft's combat weapons and items a cool refreshed look

This pack includes:

- The Stone Sword with missing handles to make it blend in with my Refreshed Tools pack

- More watery Trident and a bigger Mace to make them.. look pretty cool I guess

- Lava-themed Netherite Sword, more icy Snowballs and much more!

This is my second Resource Pack, and I think I made some improvements. But I would still really appreciate feedback so I can make these and new Resource packs better!

Once again, I hope at least one person out there enjoys using it :)
